summary: EShallgo Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement. The company received a deficiency notice on July 23, 2025, was granted a compliance period through January 19, 2026, and an additional period until July 20, 2026. On April 10, 2026, shareholders and the board approved a 16-for-1 reverse stock split effective April 20, 2026. Nasdaq confirmed compliance on May 4, 2026, after the closing bid price remained at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days. This is a routine listing compliance update, not a special situation.
